description: This PHP script handles the deletion of attachments in the TestLink project. It initializes necessary dependencies, checks user permissions, retrieves attachment information, performs deletion, and logs the event. It also includes utility functions for argument initialization and access rights validation.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument parameters for the page, specifically the attachment ID to delete.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to access the attachment deletion page based on project configuration.
